components.name: Primary Gold Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button for book creation or key workflows.
components.css: .ds-gold-btn { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b 0%, #d97706 100%); color: #0b0f19; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3); } .ds-gold-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.45); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fbbf24 0%, #f59e0b 100%); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-ghost-btn { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #cbd5e1; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 18px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-ghost-btn:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); color: #f8fafc; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }

components.html:
The Great Gatsby

components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; color: #f8fafc; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 4px 0; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-card-text { margin: 0; color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview: BookBuilder Studio is a dark, quiet digital workspace engineered specifically for literary exploration and progress tracking. It pairs deep obsidian background tones (#0b0f19) with warm amber and gold highlights (#f59e0b).
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian backdrop with translucent slate glass containers
Warm amber/gold accents used exclusively for key CTA actions and progress indicators
Expressive serif headlines (Cormorant Garamond) paired with crisp sans-serif UI text (Plus Jakarta Sans)
High contrast body copy (Pearl white #f8fafc and Slate #cbd5e1)
Smooth, micro-animated state feedback with exponential easing

rules.name: The Gold Rarity Rule
rules.body: Primary gold accents are reserved for key CTAs, active progress metrics, and selected states.

rules.name: The Balanced Headline Rule
rules.body: Display and section headings use text-wrap: balance to prevent awkward line breaks.

rules.name: The Flat Glass Rule
rules.body: Cards sit flat at rest with a 1px glass border; elevation lift appears on hover.

dos: Do maintain deep obsidian (#0b0f19) as the primary background tone.
Do ensure body text reaches at least 4.5:1 contrast against background surfaces.
Do use Cormorant Garamond for book titles and high-level section headings.
donts: Don't use generic corporate SaaS layouts, dense spreadsheet grids, or harsh 1px solid gray borders.
Don't apply decorative gradient text (background-clip: text) or 2D grid background lines.
Don't over-round cards with 32px+ border radii.
